shortDescription: Interactive GitHub-inspired home entry with switchable dashboard and profile views.
fullDescription: Renders the github-dashboard-home and github-user-profile-overview views from a single route with a local view selector and explicit state props. The dashboard home view includes the shared GitHub-style top bar, a left home sidebar, an activity feed with selectable filters, and a trending repositories panel, while the profile overview view includes the same top bar, profile navigation tabs, a left profile summary column, a popular repositories grid, and a yearly contribution heatmap with selectable years.
